newsitem.title: UK: WHSmith down on office supplies sale doubts.
newsitem.headline: WHSmith down on office supplies sale doubts.

text.p: Retailer W.H. Smith Group Plc's shares came under pressure after a newspaper report cast doubt on the terms of the sale of its business supplies division.

Analysts said a report in London's Evening Standard newspaper suggested there were concerns over negotiations of the value of net assets. Smith's shares were 11.5 pence down at 435.5 pence by 1330 GMT.

A spokesman for the company said the disposal, announced in April, was going ahead. He said negotiations were taking place on the net asset value but he did not anticipate there would be any significant financial implication for W.H. Smith.
The retailer announced in April it had sold its business supplies operations to French office stationery group Guilbert SA for 142 million stg as part of a major restructuring.
Smith said at the time the price was subject to adjustment if the unit's net assets at March 31 1996 were less than the expected 30 million stg. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
